title: A constructible subset of a closed subset with retrocompact open complement is constructible in the ambient space
statement: Let $Y$ be a topological space and let $Z\subseteq Y$ be a closed subset, with the subspace topology, whose complement $Y\setminus Z$ is retrocompact in $Y$ [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Let $G\subseteq Z$ be a constructible subset of the topological space $Z$ [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Then $G$ is a constructible subset of $Y$ (Stacks Topology, Lemma 09YG).
